body: The backtrace is somewhat similar to #119923, which has an open PR: #119924.

> We should only crash if the error is unrecoverable and would lead to a crash if unhandled. Is that the case here?

Yea. Wayland errors are unrecoverable. It would still be nice to at least save the project, if possible.

That said, the backtrace and error here are deceptive. The embedder isn't relaying the error and crashing, which in turn looks like the compositor disappearing from under the client.

It is very similar to that open PR, yes, but the real error talks about an `xdg_positioner` which is basically a popup position hint. That PR seems to only handle toplevels instead.

The same crash can also occur when just focusing the editor back from another window (it happened once when I clicked the window's title bar (KWin decoration)).

I also tried bisecting the issue, since it happens so often now on my end, and I'm 99% certain it started happening after #120726 was merged. I don't see how it relates to the crash I described just above, but I can't reproduce on ea0f3a29f0fc4912592b1e433a67bae5f4d3d705, while I get crashes on b41c5c28122d45394701f18a3af23d7a4feaad26 (merge commit for #120726).

Note that it doesn't happen every time a documentation popup/tooltip appears, I can usually see those (and the warnings/errors) just fine, but crashes start happening after that PR merge.
Well it makes sense at least, as the error is due to a popup-related object. I'll take a closer look soon, hopefully.

Did not happen in 4.7 and in 4.8 I'm getting it quite often, so it's some serious regression.
